title: Human baseline for next-hour glucose
thesis_one_line: There is no published human baseline for next-hour CGM prediction; Sugar-Sugar is the live study that measures one.
key_facts_to_include: live URL https://sugar-sugar.study; ethics A 2026-0064 Rostock; 3 hours context then 60 minutes drawn as 12 points; 6-12 rounds; MAE and RMSE in mg/dL; target about 200 adults; formats A/B/C; BIG IDEAs and D1NAMO; Nightscout not fully implemented
assets_needed: desktop screenshot of a drawn line vs the real trace; one share-card PNG from a real or staging playthrough
notes: The live study page is the pillar URL once week-zero screenshots exist. Do not invent participant counts.
